purpose: Listening-only audition pack for eight already-received cue WAVs from two fixed source commits. The eight WAV files are copied byte-for-byte; no gain normalization, mixing, synthesis, transcoding, resampling, blind ranking across projects, or game wiring.

measurementNotes.peakDbfs: 20*log10(max|PCM16 sample|/32768), rounded to 4 decimals, measured from the copied WAV bytes. The FPS source manifest records -12.0007 from 20*log10(8230/32767) on its quantized integer peak sample; this pack records -12.001 from 20*log10(8230/32768) on the same integer samples. The 0.0003 dB difference comes from the full-scale denominator (32767 vs 32768), not from quantization.
measurementNotes.firstLastSample: PCM16 integer sample values; both ends are 0 per the source 5 ms edge-envelope contract.
measurementNotes.duration: frames / sampleRate, with the exact frame count recorded per cue.

checks: Each local WAV exists and its full SHA-256 and byte length match this manifest.
Each local WAV is RIFF/WAVE, 48 kHz, mono, PCM16, and its frame count matches the manifest duration.
First and last PCM samples are 0, matching the source edge-envelope contract.
Sample peak and peak dBFS match this manifest.
All eight fixed tags exist exactly once, and no extra WAV files are present.
audition.html references only existing local relative WAVs and contains no autoplay, script, remote URL or other external dependency.

reuseCheck: No existing same-purpose public audition batch was found under docs/collaboration/local-jobs/artifacts when this unit started. The eight source WAVs were copied once into this pack; no second generation of the same-named sounds was made.
unverified: No human or automated listening test has been performed for this pack; no audio device, sound card, GUI or browser was opened.
No gain normalization, loudness matching, mixing, overlap playback or device-volume comparison was performed.
No real combat-overlap recording exists here, so masking of enemy gunfire, event synchronization, mix priority and in-game adoption cannot be judged from these single files.
File peak is not perceived loudness; the source batches differ in file peak and no listening claim about relative level is made.
Nothing in this pack is wired into either game or changes runtime audio, HUD or simulation.
